adjudication.rationale: In `lib/topic_retriever.rb`, `perform_retrieve` calls `fetch_http` unconditionally if no existing `TopicEmbed` is found, even when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true and after running `Jobs::PollFeed` (it only `return`s early if the embed is created). `fetch_http` then attempts `TopicEmbed.import_remote` as long as it can resolve a user from `SiteSetting.embed_by_username` (and host validation already passed). So the diff indeed implements an HTTP fallback path that stays active whenever embedding is configured, not only when RSS polling is intended/desired. This is a scope/feature-flagging concern rather than a directly verifiable defect, since the diff doesn’t define a setting to restrict imports to RSS-only.
